purpose: The two reading fonts a student can choose under Reading tools > Letters in every Packets file. dev-tools/build_take_home_fonts.cjs puts them inside word_sounds_take_home_loader.js, which puts them inside each file it makes. A file loads nothing, so a font must travel inside it.
subset: latin, regular weight (400) only: bold is drawn by the browser from the regular letters. Letters outside the subset fall back to the device's own fonts.
